item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
Upcoming public meetings and notable government actions in Bentonville for August 11–26.
Upcoming public meetings August 11–26. Finance Committee (Aug 11), Combined Committee of the Whole and City Council (Aug 11), Board of Adjustments (Aug 12), Utility Board (Aug 18), Planning Commission (Aug 18), Tree and Landscape Committee (Aug 20), Public Art Advisory Board (Aug 20), and Finance Committee (Aug 25). Agendas are posted for some meetings; details are available on the city portal.
Heat advisory for Benton County. A Heat Advisory is in effect until 8 PM CDT Sunday, with heat index values up to 108 expected. Cooling centers are available in Fayetteville.
Northwest Arkansas growth and business briefs. Local business owners report growth benefits and challenges. Art on Square expansion opens; Simmons Foods promotes two executives and creates a chief commercial officer position.
Taziki’s opens Rogers location. Taziki’s Mediterranean Café opened at 1771 W. Pleasant Grove Road, Suite 104 in Rogers, with about $950,000 invested.
Walton Family Foundation grant to NWACC. The Walton Family Foundation provided a $599,139 grant to NorthWest Arkansas Community College to expand its LIFE program.
Benton County One-Cent sales tax discussion. Benton County held an intergovernmental meeting to discuss the one-cent sales tax.
